# AGS Stones and Pavers: Site Reference

This file summarizes information published on the AGS Stones and Pavers website. The linked service pages are the preferred source for page-specific details. Project availability, design, materials, price, schedule and local requirements depend on the address and scope.

## Service territory

AGS Stones and Pavers describes its service area as Metro Atlanta. The site lists Atlanta, Alpharetta, Buckhead, Cumming, Duluth, Johns Creek, Marietta, Milton, Roswell, Sandy Springs, Smyrna and Suwanee. Ask the company to confirm availability for a particular property.

Service area directory: https://www.agsstonesandpavers.com/service-areas

## General project considerations

These are planning topics, not a substitute for a site assessment or local approval:

- Driveways: intended vehicle use, existing surface, access, grading, drainage, base preparation, paver selection and edge details.
- Patios: intended use, dimensions, connection to the house and yard, access, material, steps, grading and water flow.
- Retaining walls: wall dimensions, grade, soil, drainage, nearby structures, access, property lines, engineering and jurisdictional requirements.
- Outdoor kitchens and masonry: appliance and material choices, layout, utility routes, circulation, site access and local approvals.
- Pool decks: existing surface, coping, finish, wet traction, drainage, access and the manufacturer’s care guidance for selected materials.
- Decks: height, framing, materials, access, steps, connections to other outdoor surfaces, permits and inspections.
- Stone veneer: substrate, exposure, moisture management, product requirements, material selection and finish.
- Landscape and hardscape planning: goals, dimensions, existing features, access, slope, drainage, materials and approval needs.

Cost and schedule depend on the actual scope, property conditions, selected materials, access, weather and any required approvals. Request an estimate to discuss the project: https://www.agsstonesandpavers.com/quote
